name: Kouhara Yui
source:
Class: 3rd year student in the special advance class
Zodiac Sign: Taurus
Musical Instrument: Violin
Hobbies: Reading, napping

A beautiful girl who hates men. For Kazuki, she has an attitude of indifference.
At the last year's music festival she has been forcing herself forces with her Feather Partner. She isn't very good with her special instrument - the violin. But she majored in music therapy because her future dream is to work in that field.
The school garden is her favorite place, she seems to like taking a nap or reading in that place.
Yui is in a pretty close relationship with Nanami, but she doesn't have any other friends except for Nanami, and this makes her often feel lonely.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=660669]Getchu (NSFW)[/url].]
